body:
Thanks for keeping this draft until live validation — agree.

Design looks sound (pre-draw timestamp, strip from client/telemetry, age across reset, clear on stop). Please rebase onto main after #1/#2 land (shared main.ts/runner.ts/docs), get CI green, skim overhead of the 250 ms timer under load, then undraft and ping for review.

Maintainer rebase of this work onto current `main` (after #1 and #2) is in https://github.com/yoheinakajima/glance-speedlab/pull/4 — same feature, original authorship kept, `pnpm check` and CI green. This draft can stay open or be closed once #4 lands; no action needed from you unless you want to review #4.

Superseded by the maintainer rebase in #4, which is now squash-merged into `main` (`20af87b`). Closing this draft so the open queue stays clear. Thanks @kvnloo — original commits and authorship were preserved on the rebased branch.
